messages:
jamie: Heads up — new hire Mateo Rivera (NYC) says courier is holding his I-9 dropoff because they want passport instead of license, ticket C-482. Day 1 is Monday. Can we route him to a kiosk or approve a remote workaround? cc @sasha_it @maria :wave:

maria: On it. Checking courier SLA + background. Do we have Mateo's submitted ID docs in Workday?

alex_m: I can meet him at the 45th St kiosk and verify in-person if courier can't. I have a 10am slot free Monday.

sasha_it: If Mateo is in NYC and fine to come in, kiosk is simplest. I can reserve a badge pickup & laptop locker. Need full name + DOB to pre-print.

bg-checks-bot: Background check update for Mateo Rivera — completed. No matches. I-9 flag: passport expiry noted. Case BG-7721.

jamie: Mateo's DOB 1994-07-12. Passport expiry 2026-05-01. HR policy question: do we accept passports expiring within 6 months at verification? Also can notarized copies be used for remote hires?

maria: Quick policy check: passport must be unexpired at verification. Expiring within 6 months is still technically valid. Notarized copy is acceptable only for remote hires combined with an employer-attested virtual check; but easiest is in-person kiosk.

alex_m: Mateo said he can come in but prefers 10:30. Can we move slot to 10:30? I'll meet him then. Also will need a shuttle pass if he needs help getting there.

sasha_it: Booked 10:30 Mon at 45th St kiosk. Badge and laptop locker reserved. Mateo contact: mateo.rivera@example.com. Holding courier package until Tue per request. Sending calendar invite now. :white_check_mark:

jamie: Updated onboarding checklist: I-9 verification Mon 10:30, laptop pickup 11:00, orientation 13:00. Mateo — pls bring passport + secondary ID (driver's license).

mateo: Thanks everyone — coming in Monday at 10:30. Quick Q: if my passport gets flagged can I bring a notarized copy instead? I'm okay coming in but want the fallback.

maria: If you come in person we won't need notarized copy. Bring both passport + license and we're good. If plans change, ping us and we'll arrange virtual notary instructions.

courier-bot: /hold C-482 until 2026-03-10 — package held per request. Tracking: https://courier.example/track/C-482

alex_m: All set from my side. I'll meet Mateo at kiosk entrance at 10:25 and bring the verification checklist printed.

jamie: Perfect — closing loop. Will mark I-9 resolved after verification. :tada:
